messages:
maria: Quick ping — I opened two docs PRs that need reviewers today. One is a tiny SDK snippet fix and link update (PR #3241), the other is the migration guide rewrite for the dedicated runtime (PR #3247) which is larger and needs two eyes. I don't want these to sit in the queue over the weekend.
josh: I can do the SDK snippet one now, should be < 10m. Is there a docs-preview link? I saw some linkcheck flakes earlier.
maria: thanks. preview failed for the snippet PR with linkcheck. docs-bot gave this error: `mdbook-linkcheck: external link timed out (https://old.example.com/sdk)` — it retries but it's flaky.
docs-bot: Automated: Preview build failed for PR #3241 — logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/docs-preview/3241 — retry with `/run-docs-preview 3241`.
lee: I can take the migration guide in the afternoon (after 3pm PT). Heads up: the migration guide touches code examples in multiple SDKs so it should get at least 2 reviewers, one docs + one runtime engineer.
sam: I can do the runtime-engineer pass on the migration guide tomorrow morning. If lee picks it up today for copy/flow, then I'll follow for correctness.
ara: For the linkcheck flake, two options: (1) temporarily convert the link to the canonical redirect (works today) or (2) add frontmatter `skip-linkcheck: true` to that specific page and add a tech debt issue to re-validate. I'd prefer (1) unless it's a redirect we can't rely on.
josh: I'll re-run preview and if it still flakes I'll swap to the redirect. Running now: `/run-docs-preview 3241`.
maria: For assignments: can we avoid pinging the whole docs channel? Maybe add a small on-call rotation so reviewer coverage is predictable. Current rotation spreadsheet is outdated.
lee: Agreed. Proposal: one reviewer-on-duty per sprint who takes small PRs (<15 lines) and triages medium ones. Big migration guides still follow ad-hoc pairing (docs + eng). We can keep the spreadsheet and add a 'on-duty' column synced with the calendar.
sam: Also suggest a tiny workflow tweak: label `docs-review-quick` for <15-line fixes. Then we can have a GitHub Action that auto-assigns the on-duty person when that label is added.
ara: Love it. I can add a GH Action snippet to the infra repo. Example YAML snippet I'll propose:
```yaml
on: issues
# simplified: assign when label added
jobs:
  assign:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions-ecosystem/action-add-labels@v1
``` 
maria: Nice. For today — josh will handle #3241, lee + sam will cover #3247. After josh merges the tiny PR, can we have the preview cache invalidated for the migration guide? Sometimes old previews cause outdated links.
josh: I'll merge #3241 once CI green. Then I'll post here and trigger `/run-docs-preview 3247` for a fresh build.
docs-bot: Automated: Preview build succeeded for PR #3241 after retry — https://ci.internal/redwood/docs-preview/3241/summary
maria: Awesome, thank you. Lee, ping me when you start editing the migration guide so I can drop in a couple of diagrams I'm reworking.
lee: Will do. Starting edits at ~15:10 PT. Adding `review-requested: lee` on #3247 and tagging `docs-review-quick` on the snippet PR so the action can pick it up next sprint.
sam: I'll claim the runtime check on #3247 in the morning and leave the final signoff comment.
ara: I'll open the infra PR for the assign action and drop the simple matcher for `docs-review-quick` label.
maria: This is great. Can we also add a short blurb to the docs CONTRIBUTING.md explaining the on-duty label flow so new contributors know who to ping?
lee: I'll add a one-paragraph note in the CONTRIBUTING PR I'm about to open.
josh: All good from me — merging #3241 now when CI finishes. :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks team. If anything stalls, ping me directly. I'll follow up with a calendar event for the on-duty rotation and update the spreadsheet.
josh: merged #3241 — green.
maria: confirmed preview replacement and scheduling note incoming. Cheers! :party-parrot:
